description: This file contains functions for estimating the number of Physical Resource Blocks (PRBs) needed for payload transmission in a 5G NR scheduler, including estimation algorithms, calculations based on 3GPP specifications, and a linear search for optimal PRB count.

methods.name: estimate_nof_info_payload_higher_3824_bits
methods.description: Estimates the number of information bits for payloads above 3824 bits based on an approximation algorithm.

methods.name: ocudu::estimate_required_nof_prbs
methods.description: Estimates the required number of PRBs to accommodate a payload, considering payload size and MCS parameters.

methods.name: linear_search_nof_prbs_upper_bound
methods.description: Performs a linear search to find the minimal number of PRBs such that TBS >= payload size, starting from an initial estimate.

methods.name: ocudu::get_nof_prbs
methods.description: Main function to compute the optimal number of PRBs given a scheduler configuration and maximum available RBs.
